title: Wake After Sleep Onset (WASO)
alternateFormula: WASO = TRT − initial sleep latency − TST
lesson: These attended PSG calculations define WASO as wake scored after the first sleep epoch through lights on, including terminal wake if present. Subtract TST from the interval after sleep onset, or subtract sleep latency and TST from TRT.
memoryClue: WASO is wake after sleep starts—not the wake before sleep onset.
coachBobNote: If your answer accidentally includes initial sleep latency, you calculated total wake time rather than WASO.

guided.prompt: TRT is 480 minutes, sleep onset latency is 20 minutes, and TST is 405 minutes. Calculate WASO through lights on in minutes.

commonErrors.message: That includes initial sleep latency. WASO begins only after sleep onset.
